state.objective: Confirm the arithmetic production COA count after adding proven accounts not present in the approved core list.
facts: The approved core CSV contains exactly 121 accounts.
The 121 list contains no natural account named or keyed for Contract in Progress/CIP.
The 121 list contains no rent-expense natural account. It contains prepaid rent, but prepaid rent is an asset and cannot replace rent expense.
The available current asset register contains 668 CIP rows and the balance sheet contains a non-zero CIP balance.
The comparative P&L shows active store/warehouse rent expense and staff-house/mess rent expense.
Jev previously selected one governed CIP account with confidence 1.0 and two active rent-expense natures with confidence 0.99.
Therefore the proposed production set is 121 existing core accounts plus one CIP plus two rent expense accounts.
Up to 104 legacy accounts remain frozen migration-only and are excluded from transaction-form account search.
proposed_additions: Construction/Contract in Progress (CIP), dimensions project_id and site_id.
Rent Expense - Store/Warehouse, dimensions facility_id, contract_id and site_id.
Rent Expense - Staff House/Mess, dimensions facility_id, contract_id and site_id.

count_math.instructions: What is the production COA count when three proven, non-duplicated accounts are added to an exact 121-account core?

criteria.225: Include frozen legacy accounts as production.

cip_not_prepaid.instructions: Can CIP be represented by an existing prepaid, fixed-asset cost or operating-expense account without a CIP control account?

criteria.no: CIP requires a separate control account until assets are placed in service.

rent_not_prepaid.instructions: Can active rent expense be represented only by the existing prepaid-rent asset account?

criteria.no: Prepaid rent and recognized rent expense have different statement classification and must remain distinct.
criteria.yes: One prepaid asset account covers expense recognition.

two_rent.instructions: Given material active store/warehouse and staff-house/mess use, should the two rent expense natures remain separate pending contract review?

criteria.yes: Their use, control and possible tax/benefit treatment differ; facility/contract/site remain dimensions.
criteria.none: No rent expense account is needed.

production_final.instructions: What should be called the final production COA for implementation now?

criteria.124: 124 posting accounts, subject only to future evidence-based refinements.
criteria.225: 225 posting accounts including all migration holds.
criteria.142: 142 conditional target accounts despite missing evidence.

migration_label.instructions: How should the remaining legacy accounts be described?

criteria.frozen: Up to 104 frozen migration-only accounts, declining as reclassification is completed; not part of the normal production COA.
